purpose: Root-cause falsification test under isolated single-model loads. NOT candidate evaluation. Reconciles contradictory claims: (f5c4553) 'Voyage/Jina passed 500/500' vs (947d349) 'only Qwen stable; Voyage/Jina silently routed'.

protocol.workload: 500 passages, batch sizes 1/8/32, 20-request warmup, length probe 32-4096 chars
protocol.isolation_method: lms ps verified exactly one model loaded before each cell (NOT /v1/models, which returns the 17-entry catalog regardless of load state)
protocol.cold_definition: fresh lms load immediately before run, no prior requests in this load state
protocol.warm_definition: re-run without reload, model already exercised
protocol.no_retry_policy: harness does NOT retry through crashes or 400s (a failure is recorded, not masked)
protocol.routing_check: resp_model field recorded on every 2xx response

caveat_on_isolation_check: The pre-existing scripts/preflight_embedding_host.py and the original routing audit both used /v1/models to verify 'model loaded'. That endpoint returns the full 17-entry downloaded catalog regardless of actual load state, so any 'model loaded' check based on it is unreliable. This falsification used lms ps instead. Prior preflight pass/fail conclusions that depended on /v1/models load checks should be treated as unverified pending re-run.
